versions.content: Only one ISignalTriggering in case of PDU fan-out If an ISignalIPdu is defined to be fan-out to several PhysicalChannels, then it is sufficient that the ISignalTriggerings of that ISignalIPdu are aggregated by one of the target PhysicalChannels. It is irrelevant by which PhysicalChannel the ISignalTriggerings are aggre- gated, as long as one of the transporting PhysicalChannels aggregates the ISignalTriggerings.

Only one ISignalTriggering in case of PDU fan-out If an ISignalIPdu is defined to be fan-out to several PhysicalChannel s, then it is sufficient that the ISignalTriggering s of that ISignalIPdu are aggregated by one of the target PhysicalChannel s. It is irrelevant by which PhysicalChannel the ISignalTriggering s are aggre- gated, as long as one of the transporting PhysicalChannel s aggregates the ISignalTriggering s.
